title: digit.bindingTenants: one value of the tenant member index
description: Multi-valued Keycloak user attribute: the tenantId of every digit.bindings record, removed ones included, written in the same PUT. It lets GET /identity/v1/workspace-members page with GET /users?q=digit.bindingTenants:<tenantId> instead of scanning the realm. It never authorizes anything; the binding state lives in digit.bindings.
